verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Tanzeelul-kitaabi mina Allaahil-azeezil-hakeem
Innaa anzalnaa ilaykal-kitaaba bil-haqqi fa'budi Allaaha mukhlisan lahud-deen

Alaa Lillaahid-deenul-khaalisu wal-ladheena ittakhadhoo min doonihi awliyaa'a maa na'buduhum illaa liyuqarriboonaa ilaa Allaahi zulfaa innallaaha yahkumu baynahum fee maa hum feehi yakhtalifoona innallaaha laa yahdee man huwa kaadhibun kaffaar
Law araada Allaahu an yattakhidha waladan laastafaa mimmaa yakhluqu maa yashaa'u subhaanahu huwallaahul-waahidul-qahhaar
Khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda bil-haqqi yukawwirul-layla alan-nahaari wa yukawwirun-nahaara alal-layli wa sakhkharash-shamsa wal-qamara kullun yajree li'jalin musamman alaa huwal-azeezul-ghaffaar

Khalaqakum min nafsin waahidatin thumma ja'ala minhaa zawjahaa wa anzala lakum minal-an'aam thamaaniyata azwaajin yakhluqukum fee butooni ummahaatikum khalqan min ba'di khalqin fee zulumaatin thalaathin dhalikumu Allaahu rabbukum lahul-mulku laa ilaaha illaa huwa fa-annaa tusrafoon

In takfuroo fa-innallaaha ghaniyyun ankum wa laa yardaa li-ibaadihil-kufra wa in tashkuroo yardahu lakum wa laa taziru waaziratun wizra ukhraa thumma ilaa rabbikum marji'ukum fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'maloona innahu aleemun bidhaatis-sudoor

Wa idhaa massal-insaana durrun da'aa rabbahu muneeban ilayhi thumma idhaa khawwalahu ni'matan minhu nasiya maa kaana yad'oo ilayhi min qablu wa ja'ala Lillaahi andaadan liyudilla an sabeelihi qul tamatta bikufrika qaleelan innaka min ashaabin-naar
Amman huwa qaanitun aanaa'al-layli saajidan wa qaa'iman yahdharul-aakhirata wa yarjoo rahmata rabbihi qul hal yastawil-ladheena ya'lamoona wal-ladheena laa ya'lamoona innamaa yatadhakkaru ulul-albaab
Qul yaa ibaadil-ladheena aamanoo ittaqoo rabbakum lilladheena ahsanoo fee haadhihid-dunyaa hasanatun wa ardu Allaahi waasi'atun innamaa yuwaffas-saabiroona ajrahum bighayri hisaab
Qul innee umirtu an a'buda Allaaha mukhlisan lahud-deen
Wa umirtu li'n akoona awwalal-muslimeen
Qul innee akhaafu in asaytu rabbee adhaaba yawmin azeem
Quli Allaaha a'budu mukhlisan lahu deen
Fa'budoo maa shi'tum min doonihi qul innal-khaasireenal-ladheena khasiroo anfusahum wa ahleehim yawmal-qiyaamati alaa dhaalika huwal-khusraanul-mubeen
Lahum min fawqihim zulalun minan-naari wa min tahtihim zulalun dhaalika yukhawwifu Allaahu bihi ibaadahu yaa ibaadi fattaqoon
Wal-ladheena ijtanabut-taaghoota an ya'budoohaa wa anaaboo ilaa Allaahi lahumul-bushraa fabashshir ibaad
Al-ladheena yastami'oonal-qawla fayattabi'oona ahsanahu ulaa'ikal-ladheena hadaahumu Allaahu wa ulaa'ika hum ulul-albaab
Afaman haqqa alayhi kalimatul-adhaabi afa'anta tunqidhu man fin-naar
Lakinil-ladheena ittaqaw rabbahum lahum ghurafun min fawqihaa ghurafun mabniyyatun tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru wa'da Allaahi laa yukhlifu Allaahul-mee'aad

Alam taraa annallaaha anzala minas-samaa'i maa'an fasalakahu yanaabee'a fil-ardi thumma yukhriju bihi zar'an mukhtalifan alwaanuhu thumma yaheeju fataraahu musfarran thumma yaj'aluhu hutaaman inna fee dhaalika ladhikraa li'wlil-albaab
Afaman sharaha Allaahu sadrahu lil-islaami fahuwa alaa noorin min rabbihi fawaylun lilqaasiyati quloobuhum min dhikri Allaahi ulaa'ika fee dalaalin mubeen

Allaahu nazzala ahsanal-hadeethi kitaaban mutashaabihan mathaaniya taqsha'irru minhu juloodul-ladheena yakhshawna rabbahum thumma taleenu julooduhum wa quloobuhum ilaa dhikri Allaahi dhaalika hudaa Allaahi yahdee bihi man yashaa'u wa man yudlili Allaahu famaa lahu min haad
Afaman yattaqee biwajhihi soo'al-adhaabi yawmal-qiyaamati wa qeela liz-zaalimeena dhooqoo maa kuntum taksiboon
Kadhdhabal-ladheena min qablihim fa-ataahumul-adhaabu min haythu laa yash'uroon
Fa-adhaaqahumu Allaahul-khizya fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wa la-adhaabul-aakhirati akbaru law kaanoo ya'lamoon
Wa laqad darabnaa lin-naasi fee haadhal-qur'aani min kulli mathalin la-allahum yatadhakkaroon
Qur'aanan arabiyyan ghayra dhee iwajin la-allahum yattaqoon
Daraba Allaahu mathalan rajulan feehi shurakaa'u mutashaakisoona wa rajulan salaman lirajulin hal yastawiyaani mathalan al-hamdu Lillaahi bal aktharuhum laa ya'lamoon
Innaka mayyitun wa innahum mayyitoon
Thumma innakum yawmal-qiyaamati inda rabbikum takhtasimoon
Faman azlamu mimman kadhaba alaa Allaahi wa kadhdhaba bis-sidqi idh jaa'ahu alaysa fee jahannama mathwan lilkaafireen
Wal-ladhee jaa'a bis-sidqi wa saddaqa bihi ulaa'ika humul-muttaqoon
Lahum maa yashaa'oona inda rabbihim dhaalika jazaa'ul-muhsineen
Liyukaffira Allaahu anhum aswa'al-ladhee amiloo wa yajziyahum ajrahum bi-ahsanil-ladhee kaanoo ya'maloon
Alaysa Allaahu bikaafin abdahu wa yukhawwifoonaka billadheena min doonihi wa man yudlili Allaahu famaa lahu min haad
Wa man yahdi Allaahu famaa lahu min mudillin alaysa Allaahu bi-azeezin dhin-tiqaam

Wa la-in sa'altahum man khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda layaqoolunna Allaahu qul afara'aytum maa tad'oona min doonillaahi in araadaniya Allaahu bidurrin hal hunna kaashifaatu durrihi aw araadanee birahmatin hal hunna mumsikaatu rahmatihi qul hasbiya Allaahu alayhi yatawakkalul-mutawakkiloon
Qul yaa qawmi i'maloo alaa makaanatikum innee aamilun fasawfa ta'lamoon
Man ya'teehi adhaabun yukhzeehi wa yahillu alayhi adhaabun muqeem
Innaa anzalnaa alaykal-kitaaba lin-naasi bil-haqqi famani ihtadaa falinafsihi wa man dalla fa-innamaa yadillu alayhaa wa maa anta alayhim biwakeel

Allaahu yatawaffal-anfusa heena mawtihaa wa-atee lam tamut fee manaamihaa fayumsikul-latee qadaa alayhal-mawta wa yursilul-ukhraa ilaa ajalin musamman inna fee dhaalika la-aayaatin liqawmin yatafakkaroon
Amit-takhadhoo min doonillaahi shufa'aa'a qul awalaw kaanoo laa yamlikoona shay'an wa laa ya'qiloon
Qul Lillaahish-shafaa'atu jamee'an lahu mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi thumma ilayhi turja'oon
Wa idhaa dhukira Allaahu wahdahu ishma'azzat quloobul-ladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati wa idhaa dhukiral-ladheena min doonihi idhaa hum yastabshiroon
Quli Allaahumma faatiras-samaawaati wal-ardi aalimal-ghaybi wash-shahaadati anta tahkumu bayna ibaadika fee maa kaanoo feehi yakhtalifoon
Wa law anna lilladheena zalamoo maa fil-ardi jamee'an wa mithlahu ma'ahu laftadaw bihi min soo'il-adhaabi yawmal-qiyaamati wa badaa lahum mina Allaahi maa lam yakoonoo yahtasiboon
Wa badaa lahum sayyi'aatu maa kasaboo wa haaqa bihim maa kaanoo bihi yastahzi'oon
Fa-idhaa massal-insaana durrun da'aanaa thumma idhaa khawwalnaahu ni'matan minnaa qaala innamaa ooteetuhu alaa ilmin bal hiya fitnatun wa laakinna aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
Qad qaalahal-ladheena min qablihim famaa aghnaa anhum maa kaanoo yaksiboon
Fa-asaabahum sayyi'aatu maa kasaboo wal-ladheena zalamoo min haa'ulaa'i sayuseebuhum sayyi'aatu maa kasaboo wa maa hum bimu'jizeen
Awalam ya'lamoo annallaaha yabsutur-rizqa liman yashaa'u wa yaqdiru inna fee dhaalika la-aayaatin liqawmin yu'minoon
Qul yaa ibaadil-ladheena asrafoo alaa anfusihim laa taqnatoo min rahmati Allaahi innallaaha yaghfirudh-dhunooba jamee'an innahu huwal-ghafoorur-Raheem
Wa aneeboo ilaa rabbikum wa aslimoo lahu min qabli an ya'tiyakumul-adhaabu thumma laa tunsaroon
Wattabi'oo ahsana maa unzila ilaykum min rabbikum min qabli an ya'tiyakumul-adhaabu baghtatan wa antum laa tash'uroon
An taqoola nafsun yaa hasrataa alaa maa farrattu fee janbi Allaahi wa in kuntu laminas-saakhireen
Aw taqoola law annallaaha hadaanee lakuntu minal-muttaqeen
Aw taqoola heena taral-adhaaba law anna lee karratan fa-akoona minal-muhsineen
Balaa qad jaa'atka aayaatee fakadhdhabta bihaa wastakbarta wa kunta minal-kaafireen
Wa yawmal-qiyaamati taral-ladheena kadhaboo alaa Allaahi wujoohuhum muswaddatun alaysa fee jahannama mathwan lilmutakabbireen
Wa yunajjee Allaahul-ladheena ittaqaw bimafaazatihim laa yamassuhumus-soo'u wa laa hum yahzanoon
Allaahu khaaliqu kulli shay'in wa huwa alaa kulli shay'in wakeel
Lahu maqaaleedus-samaawaati wal-ardi wal-ladheena kafaroo bi-aayaati Allaahi ulaa'ika humul-khaasiroon
Qul afaghayra Allaahi ta'muroonnee a'budu ayyuhal-jaahiloon
Wa laqad oohiya ilayka wa ilal-ladheena min qablika la-in ashrakta layahbatanna amaluka wa latakoonanna minal-khaasireen
Bali Allaaha fa'bud wa kun minash-shaakireen
Wa maa qadaroo Allaaha haqqa qadrihi wal-ardu jamee'an qabdatuhu yawmal-qiyaamati was-samaawaatu matwiyyaatun biyameenihi subhaanahu wa ta'aalaa ammaa yushrikoon
Wa nufikha fis-soori fasa'iqa man fis-samaawaati wa man fil-ardi illaa man shaa'a Allaahu thumma nufikha feehi ukhraa fa-idhaa hum qiyaamun yanzuroon
Wa ashraqatil-ardu binoori rabbihaa wa wudi'al-kitaabu wa jee'a bin-nabiyyeena wash-shuhadaa'i wa qudiya baynahum bil-haqqi wa hum laa yuzlamoon
Wa wuffiyat kullu nafsin maa amilat wa huwa a'lamu bimaa yaf'aloon

Wa seeqal-ladheena kafaroo ilaa jahannama zumaran hattaa idhaa jaa'oohaa futihat abwaabuhaa wa qaala lahum khazanatuhaa alam ya'tikum rusulun minkum yatloona alaykum aayaati rabbikum wa yundhiroonakum liqaa'a yawmikum haadhaa qaaloo balaa wa laakin haqqat kalimatul-adhaabi alal-kaafireen
Qeelad-khuloo abwaaba jahannama khaalideena feehaa fabi'sa mathwal-mutakabbireen
Wa seeqal-ladheena ittaqaw rabbahum ilal-jannati zumaran hattaa idhaa jaa'oohaa wa futihat abwaabuhaa wa qaala lahum khazanatuhaa salaamun alaykum tibtum fadkhuloohaa khaalideen
Wa qaalul-hamdu Lillaahil-ladhee sadaqanaa wa'dahu wa awrathanal-arda natabawwa'u minal-jannati haythu nashaa'u fani'ma ajrul-aamileen
Wa taral-malaa'ikata haaffeena min hawlil-arshi yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim wa qudiya baynahum bil-haqqi wa qeelal-hamdu Lillaahi rabbil-aalameen
